briefdescription.para: WaterList - A sorted list of basic blocks where islands could be placed (i.e.

detaileddescription.para: blocks that don't fall through to the following block, due to a return, unreachable, or unconditional branch).

briefdescription.para: NewWaterList - The subset of WaterList that was created since the previous iteration by inserting unconditional branches.
CPUsers - Keep track of all of the machine instructions that use various constant pools and their max displacement.
CPEntries - Keep track of all of the constant pool entry machine instructions.

detaileddescription.para: For each original constpool index (i.e. those that existed upon entry to this pass), it keeps a vector of entries. Original elements are cloned as we go along; the clones are put in the vector of the original element, but have distinct CPIs.
The first half of CPEntries contains generic constants, the second half contains jump tables. Use getCombinedIndex on a generic CPEMI to look up which vector it will be in here.

briefdescription.para: Maps a JT index to the offset in CPEntries containing copies of that table.

detaileddescription.para: The equivalent map for a CONSTPOOL_ENTRY is the identity.

briefdescription.para: Maps a JT index to the LEA that actually uses the index to calculate its base address.
ImmBranches - Keep track of all the immediate branch instructions.
PushPopMIs - Keep track of all the Thumb push / pop instructions.
T2JumpTables - Keep track of all the Thumb2 jumptable instructions.
runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.

inbodydescription.para: The next UID to take is the first unused one.

briefdescription.para: getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: Perform the initial placement of the regular constant pool entries.

detaileddescription.para: To start with, we put them all at the end of the function.

briefdescription.para: Do initial placement of the jump tables.

detaileddescription.para: Because Thumb2's TBB and TBH instructions can be made more efficient if the jump table immediately follows the instruction, it's best to place them immediately next to their jumps to begin with. In almost all cases they'll never be moved from that position.

briefdescription.para: BBHasFallthrough - Return true if the specified basic block can fallthrough into the block immediately after it.
findConstPoolEntry - Given the constpool index and CONSTPOOL_ENTRY MI, look up the corresponding CPEntry.
getCPEAlign - Returns the required alignment of the constant pool entry represented by CPEMI.
scanFunctionJumpTables - Do a scan of the function, building up information about the sizes of each block and the locations of all the jump tables.
initializeFunctionInfo - Do the initial scan of the function, building up information about the sizes of each block, the location of all the water, and finding all of the constant pool users.
Split the basic block containing MI into two blocks, which are joined by an unconditional branch.

detaileddescription.para: Update data structures and renumber blocks to account for this change and returns the newly created block.

briefdescription.para: updateForInsertedWaterBlock - When a block is newly inserted into the machine function, it upsets all of the block numbers.

detaileddescription.para: Renumber the blocks and update the arrays that parallel this numbering.

briefdescription.para: decrementCPEReferenceCount - find the constant pool entry with index CPI and instruction CPEMI, and decrement its refcount.

detaileddescription.para: If the refcount becomes 0 remove the entry and instruction. Returns true if we removed the entry, false if we didn't.

briefdescription.para: LookForCPEntryInRange - see if the currently referenced CPE is in range; if not, see if an in-range clone of the CPE is in range, and if so, change the data structures so the user references the clone.

detaileddescription.para: Returns: 0 = no existing entry found 1 = entry found, and there were no code insertions or deletions 2 = entry found, and there were code insertions or deletions

briefdescription.para: findAvailableWater - Look for an existing entry in the WaterList in which we can place the CPE referenced from U so it's within range of U's MI.

detaileddescription.para: Returns true if found, false if not. If it returns true, WaterIter is set to the WaterList entry. For Thumb, prefer water that will not introduce padding to water that will. To ensure that this pass terminates, the CPE location for a particular CPUser is only allowed to move to a lower address, so search backward from the end of the list and prefer the first water that is in range.

briefdescription.para: createNewWater - No existing WaterList entry will work for CPUsers[CPUserIndex], so create a place to put the CPE.

detaileddescription.para: The end of the block is used if in range, and the conditional branch munged so control flow is correct. Otherwise the block is split to create a hole with an unconditional branch around it. In either case NewMBB is set to a block following which the new island can be inserted (the WaterList is not adjusted).

briefdescription.para: handleConstantPoolUser - Analyze the specified user, checking to see if it is out-of-range.

detaileddescription.para: If so, pick up the constant pool value and move it some place in-range. Return true if we changed any addresses (thus must run another pass of branch lengthening), false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: removeDeadCPEMI - Remove a dead constant pool entry instruction.

detaileddescription.para: Update sizes and offsets of impacted basic blocks.

briefdescription.para: removeUnusedCPEntries - Remove constant pool entries whose refcounts are zero.

briefdescription.para: isCPEntryInRange - Returns true if the distance between specific MI and specific ConstPool entry instruction can fit in MI's displacement field.
isWaterInRange - Returns true if a CPE placed after the specified Water (a basic block) will be in range for the specific MI.

detaileddescription.para: Compute how much the function will grow by inserting a CPE after Water.

briefdescription.para: fixupImmediateBr - Fix up an immediate branch whose destination is too far away to fit in its displacement field.
fixupConditionalBr - Fix up a conditional branch whose destination is too far away to fit in its displacement field.

detaileddescription.para: It is converted to an inverse conditional branch + an unconditional branch to the destination.

briefdescription.para: fixupUnconditionalBr - Fix up an unconditional branch whose destination is too far away to fit in its displacement field.

detaileddescription.para: If the LR register has been spilled in the epilogue, then we can use BL to implement a far jump. Otherwise, add an intermediate branch instruction to a branch.

briefdescription.para: reorderThumb2JumpTables - Adjust the function's block layout to ensure that jump tables always branch forwards, since that's what tbb and tbh need.
While trying to form a TBB/TBH instruction, we may (if the table doesn't immediately follow the BR_JT) need access to the start of the jump-table.

detaileddescription.para: We know one instruction that produces such a register; this function works out whether that definition can be preserved to the BR_JT, possibly by removing an intervening addition (which is usually needed to calculate the actual entry to jump to).

briefdescription.para: optimizeThumb2JumpTables - Use tbb / tbh instructions to generate smaller jumptables when it's possible.
getUserOffset - Compute the offset of U.MI as seen by the hardware displacement computation.

detaileddescription.para: Update U.KnownAlignment to match its current basic block location.

briefdescription.para: print block size and offset information - debugging
verify - check BBOffsets, BBSizes, alignment of islands

briefdescription.para: ARMConstantIslands - Due to limited PC-relative displacements, ARM requires constant pool entries to be scattered among the instructions inside a function.

detaileddescription.para: To do this, it completely ignores the normal LLVM constant pool; instead, it places constants wherever it feels like with special instructions.

The terminology used in this pass includes: Islands - Clumps of constants placed in the function. Water - Potential places where an island could be formed. CPE - A constant pool entry that has been placed somewhere, which tracks a list of users.
